observations: Standing fan with a black metal grill and three black blades.
Red and blue 'OX' logo is visible on the center of the grill in photo 0.
The fan has a cross-shaped (X-style) base.
The power cord is wrapped around the telescopic pole.
The speed control buttons and motor housing label are not visible.

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the manufacturer's label or a measurement.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out, weak, or excessively noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip of the fan running through all speed settings.

risks.risk: The oscillation mechanism may be seized or broken.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the fan head rotating side-to-side.

risks.risk: The speed control buttons or rear housing may be damaged.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of the motor housing and the control panel.

proof_requests: A video of the fan powered on, showing it spinning at different speeds and oscillating.
A close-up photo of the manufacturer's label on the motor housing to confirm the model and size.
A photo of the speed control buttons.
response.reason: The brand and type are clearly identified from the photos. It can be priced at its worst case as a non-functional unit until proof of operation is provided.
